name: Sign in and load the protected dashboard
description: Checks that a signed-in user receives a protected workspace after startup authentication restoration.
steps: Sign in using the secure sign-in action
expected: The authenticated user sees the dashboard and their own role; protected information is not shown while signed out.

name: Create a session and check in once
description: Checks the core attendance workflow across lecturer and student accounts.
setup: Sign in as a lecturer whose role was assigned by the owner
Sign in with a separate student account
steps: Submit the code from the student account
expected: The student has one durable verified attendance record; a repeated check-in is rejected.

name: Reject unauthorized role changes and invalid codes
description: Checks authorization boundaries and invalid attendance input on a mobile viewport.
steps: Attempt to access owner-only role assignment
expected: The invalid code is rejected, no attendance is created, and the student cannot assign roles.

name: Review saved attendance and audit events
description: Checks that saved academic activity appears in permitted dashboard and history views.
steps: Create an attendance session and record a student check-in
Open dashboard metrics and attendance history
Open audit trail as the owner account
expected: Saved activity is reflected in the relevant views and administrator-only audit data is restricted.
